neighbours.label: a stage along a chain or process (a link in the chain, every step of the process, any point along the way)
fire: Inspectors found a weak link in the supply chain for the vaccine.
Mistakes can creep in at every step of the approval process.
The grain can spoil at any point between the farm and the mill.
Each broker is one more link in the chain of ownership of the loan.
Heat is lost at several steps on its way from the boiler to the radiator.
Fraud can occur at many points in the life of an insurance claim.
Este puerto es un eslabón clave entre los productores y el mercado.
The memo was altered at some stage in its passage through the ministry.
quiet: Inspectors found a rusty padlock on the gate of the vaccine warehouse.
She climbed the steps of the town hall and knocked at the door.
The grain is stored in a large silo between the farm and the mill.
He wore a gold chain around his neck to the party on Saturday.
Heat rises from the boiler and warms the room with the radiator.
Click the link on the home page to read about your insurance claim.
Este puerto es un lugar bonito para pasear con los niños.
The pencil has a sharp point and sits on a desk in the ministry.

notes: The list link / step / point / eslabon shares one pattern: one position in a sequence that something passes through. Literal chains, stairs and web links stayed quiet in probes.
